verdict.rationale: SBOM generation is a fair question for a software-composition-analysis and container-scanning product like Snyk, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions SBOMs, SPDX, CycloneDX, or any export of a dependency inventory. Dependency scanning, license checks and the snyk-to-html report plugin are related features, not SBOM generation, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a security-engineer, I can generate a software bill of materials (SPDX or CycloneDX) for my project or image
